safety_eligibility: Any unresolved hallucinated finding, invented GO identifier, unsupported diagnosis, or misleading certainty makes a candidate ineligible. Safety eligibility is absolute and precedes all ranking.
selection: Among eligible candidates, rank by grounding and completeness first (required finding recall, required GO recall, evidence precision, zero unsupported claims), then repeatability, then performance.
stop: If neither candidate is eligible, stop Phase 5 and report the failures. Do not weaken gates, add an unplanned model, or tune against the final set.
